problem_text:
A manufacturing conglomerate is devising a strategic plan to curtail the discharge of a regulated chemical byproduct across its ten production facilities. Initially, none of the facilities employ any abatement technology.

The operational profile of each facility is defined by a baseline discharge coefficient and an annual production volume:
* Facility 1: Discharge coefficient 1.017, production volume 293.944.
* Facility 2: Discharge coefficient 0.846, production volume 86.288.
* Facility 3: Discharge coefficient 1.853, production volume 283.257.
* Facility 4: Discharge coefficient 2.5, production volume 279.278.
* Facility 5: Discharge coefficient 2.656, production volume 129.374.
* Facility 6: Discharge coefficient 1.272, production volume 189.335.
* Facility 7: Discharge coefficient 2.263, production volume 287.15.
* Facility 8: Discharge coefficient 1.81, production volume 79.597.
* Facility 9: Discharge coefficient 0.838, production volume 129.399.
* Facility 10: Discharge coefficient 2.989, production volume 269.91.

Ten distinct purification technologies are available for deployment, each characterized by a specific abatement rate:
* Technology A achieves a 32% reduction in discharge.
* Technology B achieves a 29% reduction.
* Technology C achieves a 20% reduction.
* Technology D achieves a 57% reduction.
* Technology E achieves a 57% reduction.
* Technology F achieves a 55% reduction.
* Technology G achieves a 15% reduction.
* Technology H achieves a 19% reduction.
* Technology I achieves a 15% reduction.
* Technology J achieves a 68% reduction.

Implementing a technology at a facility incurs an incremental cost per unit of production. The cost matrix (in monetary units per production unit) for each facility-technology pairing is as follows:
| Facility \ Technology | Tech A | Tech B | Tech C | Tech D | Tech E | Tech F | Tech G | Tech H | Tech I | Tech J |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| Facility 1 | 158.03 | 30.287 | 45.102 | 154.865 | 126.277 | 60.704 | 117.738 | 53.873 | 54.115 | 140.602 |
| Facility 2 | 78.26 | 140.747 | 100.554 | 105.442 | 124.895 | 145.284 | 81.052 | 171.905 | 103.375 | 36.127 |
| Facility 3 | 46.719 | 16.124 | 155.262 | 12.853 | 61.273 | 88.478 | 151.05 | 197.766 | 153.978 | 22.566 |
| Facility 4 | 186.15 | 197.269 | 174.755 | 103.089 | 71.73 | 96.934 | 56.889 | 86.925 | 17.947 | 149.713 |
| Facility 5 | 82.271 | 69.451 | 126.186 | 151.069 | 122.823 | 109.794 | 176.399 | 159.515 | 108.923 | 95.806 |
| Facility 6 | 167.132 | 18.059 | 199.209 | 108.554 | 85.166 | 149.682 | 115.963 | 108.064 | 129.823 | 19.366 |
| Facility 7 | 65.324 | 85.628 | 67.865 | 167.248 | 97.656 | 90.268 | 126.496 | 20.364 | 108.224 | 37.026 |
| Facility 8 | 167.68 | 95.823 | 147.303 | 31.503 | 157.959 | 188.19 | 142.262 | 35.708 | 88.576 | 95.668 |
| Facility 9 | 43.987 | 122.16 | 145.401 | 48.367 | 96.39 | 57.516 | 141.426 | 182.361 | 161.332 | 146.491 |
| Facility 10 | 33.473 | 31.691 | 95.386 | 78.959 | 109.525 | 82.977 | 160.303 | 107.217 | 190.453 | 81.949 |

The decision involves selecting which technologies to apply at each facility; a facility may employ multiple technologies concurrently, and partial abatement is permissible. The strategic objective is to guarantee that the aggregate chemical discharge is diminished by at least a target fraction P = 0.39 of the baseline uncontrolled emissions, while simultaneously minimizing the total implementation expenditure.
